name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: An initiative by the Government of India that provides up to ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments directly into the bank accounts of small and marginal farmers.
eligibility: Small and marginal landholder farmers families who own cultivable land holding up to 2 hectares in their names. Institutional landholders, taxpayers, and high-income families are not eligible.
application_steps: Visit the official PM-Kisan Portal (https://pmkisan.gov.in/).
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' under the Farmers Corner section.
Enter your Aadhaar number and select state, rural/urban area.
Fill in personal and land details, upload the required documents, and submit.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
description: A special micro-credit scheme providing street vendors with collateral-free working capital loans of up to ₹10,000 for the first tenure, with subsequent loans of ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 upon timely repayment.
eligibility: Urban street vendors/hawkers carrying out vending on or before March 24, 2020. Vendors must possess a Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from the local municipality/urban local body.
required_documents: Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
application_steps: Visit the PM SVANidhi portal (https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in/).
Click on 'Apply Loan' (10k, 20k, or 50k based on eligibility).
Enter your Mobile Number and Aadhaar number to verify via OTP.
Fill in the application details and select your lender bank/Lending Institution.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: Provides end-to-end support to artisans and craftspeople including recognition (Vishwakarma Certificate & ID Card), skill upgrading, toolkit incentive of ₹15,000, and collateral-free credit support up to ₹3,000,000 at concessional interest rate of 5%.
eligibility: An artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools in one of the 18 family-based traditional trades (e.g., carpenter, blacksmith, potter, sculptor, cobbler, tailor). Minimum age of 18 years. Benefit restricted to one member per family.
application_steps: Go to the Common Services Centre (CSC) for registration or visit https://pmvishwakarma.gov.in/.
Artisan verification will be done via biometric Aadhaar authentication.
Apply for the Vishwakarma Certificate and loan assistance under the guidance of the CSC agent.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
description: A scheme to bring about a Blue Revolution through sustainable development of the fisheries sector in India. Offers financial support for acquiring boats, establishing aquaculture farms, fish feed mills, and post-harvest infrastructure.
eligibility: Fishers, Fish Farmers, Fish Workers, Fish Vendors, Fisheries Co-operatives, and Self Help Groups (SHGs) involved in fisheries activities.
required_documents: Land/Pond ownership documents (if applying for aquaculture)
application_steps: Contact the local District Fisheries Office or State Fisheries Department.
Submit a detailed project report (DPR) or standard application form for the specific fisheries asset/incentive.
Details and forms can also be downloaded from the PMMSY official website (https://pmmsy.dof.gov.in/).

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
description: Guarantees at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
eligibility: Must be a citizen of India residing in rural areas. Must be an adult (above 18 years of age) willing to do unskilled manual labour.
application_steps: Apply at the local Gram Panchayat office in your village using a simple application form or plain paper request.
The Gram Panchayat will verify the details and issue a Job Card within 15 days of application.
After getting the Job Card, submit a written application for work, specifying the dates and duration. Employment will be provided within 15 days of demand.

name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card & Benefits
description: A single document of identification and verification of disabled personals that streamlines access to government schemes, pension benefits, travel concessions (railway/bus), and assistive aid distribution.
eligibility: Any citizen of India with a disability percentage of 40% or more (as certified by a registered medical authority).
required_documents: Disability Certificate (if already issued by a hospital)
application_steps: Visit the official Swavlamban Card portal (https://www.swavlambancard.gov.in/).
Click on 'Apply for Disability Certificate & UDID Card'.
Fill in the personal details, address, disability details, and employment information.
Upload photo, signature, and identity/address proof, then submit. Visit the designated government hospital for medical assessment if scheduled.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: An accident insurance scheme offering ₹2 lakh coverage for accidental death or full disability, and ₹1 lakh coverage for partial disability, at a highly subsidized premium of just ₹20 per year.
eligibility: All individual bank/post office account holders in the age group of 18 to 70 years who give their consent to join and enable auto-debit of premium.
required_documents: Bank Account details with auto-debit consent
application_steps: Contact the bank or post office where you hold your savings account.
Submit the PMSBY application and auto-debit consent form.
Alternatively, register online through the net-banking app/portal of your bank.
